en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar who said,
‘I asked himasws about the Salāt in a Jurmuq (gaiter – a large slipper), and I came with a gaiter and showed it to himasws. So heasws said: ‘One can pray Salāt in it’.
en.sarwar: 32. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar who has said the following: “

I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a Jurmuq (a larger slipper worn over another one) if it is permissible to perform Salah (prayer) with it and I showed it to him (the Imam) and he (the Imam) said, ‘It is permissible to perform Salah (prayer) with it.’”
